issue_request: FHIR-39342 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that resource.html#search explain or link the phrase pre-defined functional lists in the Resource _list search parameter to the Lifecycle page's Current Resource Lists anchor.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini maps resource to the resource page and lists Resource as a resource-infrastructure artifact, so source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml is in current build scope. A later R6 normative source change, 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd, replaced the Current Resource Lists content with a removal/API Incubator note; this supports linking to the current policy anchor but not expanding this seed into a broader current-list cleanup. FHIR-47134 is a related Resolved - change required guidance request, not Applied/Published, so it was treated as context only.
